name: Paracetamol
commonUses: Widely used for reducing fever (antipyretic) and relieving mild to moderate pain (analgesic) such as headaches, muscle aches, sore throat, or toothaches.
sideEffects: Rare side effects when taken at recommended doses.
precautions: Do not exceed the maximum daily dose of 4000 mg (4 grams) in adults. Keep at least 4-6 hours gap between doses.
warnings: Avoid double dosing by checking if other cold or cough medications also contain paracetamol. Overdose can lead to severe and potentially fatal liver damage.
source: National Health Portal (NHP) India & ICMR Clinical Guidelines
